You won your historic victory on Tuesday with the help of our America First coalition on 4 key basic issues.

1. End foreign wars, war in Iran, and funding for Israel.
2. Reduce cost of living and gas/diesel (economy)
3. End corruption in Gov
4. Reduce cost of healthcare/health insurance 

Which were also key components of the mandate delivered to Trump and Republicans, which they betrayed and failed to deliver.

Your party has two factions, older establishment Dems and younger populists Dems.

If the New Democrat majority returns to issues that lost your majority and presidency in 2024 and doesn’t stay focused on those 4 main issues, then the American populists movement that swung it big for you this cycle will not vote for you in 2028.

For example, bringing back 2020-2024 issues like woke, identity politics, forcing trans issues, gun control, Covid vaccine mandates, and open borders are not the issues that drove this massive blue tsunami.

Allowing the older establishment Democrats to run back to those issues that were defeated in the 2024 election would be a very grave mistake, tone deaf, and would completely undermine the opportunity you have before you.

The country didn’t suddenly join the Democrat Party with a sworn allegiance to always vote Democrat.

The country voted to end Trump and to refocus back to the main kitchen table issues that are hurting their lives.

And most of the younger generations of voters could care less about team party politics and just beating the other side. 

The future is all about, “deliver results for Americans” and whoever can get it done.

To be very clear, I’m conservative and have voted Republican my entire life, but went into open rebellion and war against Trump and Republicans, the man I worked tirelessly to put in office because he betrayed his promises and the Republican Party turned back to it’s repulsive neocon elite donor focused ways and refused to deliver for the American people.

Our entire coalition did, we ended the Trump era and burned our party down, but we didn’t turn into Democrats.

For both parties need to realize that most Americans want the same basic things and the future belongs to an independent minded left/right powerful coalition that will force our elected and tax payer funded government to deliver for Americans or face punishment at the polls.

Focus on the issues that won on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, not issues the American people defeated in the past.

The ball is in your court.

Good luck!

note.text:
THE 15% BAND

Look at this chart. 
59 races. Senate and governor. 
States ordered from reddest to bluest in 2024.

The solid lines are 2024. 
The dashed lines are 2026. 
The shaded bands are what moved.

One formula fits all of it:
Republican 2026 = 0.85 × Trump 2024
Democrat 2026 = Harris 2024 + 0.15 × Trump 2024

For every 1,000 Trump points, 850 stayed Republican. 150 landed on the Democratic side.

The numbers:
Senate: Republicans kept ~85% of Trump’s share
Governor: ~86%

Variation explained: 88%

What makes it strange:
It didn’t matter how red the state was. Wyoming, Ohio, Illinois, Massachusetts: same 15% (p = 0.69). The Democratic gain was sized by Trump’s vote, not Harris’s. The Harris part is zero.

The 0.85 beat both standard election-swing models in every set of races.
Drop any single state and the multiplier stays between 0.846 and 0.853.

Why seats flipped:
At 0.85, any state where Trump got under about 58.5% falls below 50%. Texas, Kansas, Iowa, Ohio, South Carolina, North Carolina: all under that line. All flipped.

What this means:
Midterms are messy. This one isn’t. Two sets of races, different candidates, different campaigns, and the same 15% decrease almost everywhere.

A pattern this even demands answers at the ballot level: paper ballot hand counts, poll-book check-ins against votes counted, and voter files showing who actually turned out. 

The numbers raise the question. 
The ballots can answer it.
